scope.description: Whole GetDP finite element and multiphysics application breadth.
scope.denominator: General 1D/2D/axisymmetric/3D formulations, scalar/vector/mixed fields, thermal/electrical/magnetic and coupled/circuit problems, steady/transient/harmonic/nonlinear solution and postprocessing.

coverage.rationale: Two useful steady scalar-conduction families are covered end to end, while general geometries, vector electromagnetics, transients, harmonic/nonlinear systems and coupling exclude most GetDP breadth.

scope.description: Layered constant-area steady thermal walls and electrical resistors with source, end-condition and sampled-limit intent.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Layered material, generation and end-condition intent determines mesh/formulation and independently verified field, flux, conservation and sampled-limit decisions; users retain explicit cells and operation-dependent units.

limitations: Serial constant-property perfectly contacting one-dimensional layers only. No arbitrary formulations/imported geometry, transient, nonlinear, radiation, harmonic, vector electromagnetic or coupled electrothermal systems.
Editorial ordinal estimates, not measured API ratios or runtime/native qualification. Mesh-node field and element-midpoint flux limits do not certify unsampled extrema or all tolerance variants.
